condition_due_not_passed.suggestion: Discharge it or agree a new date.

condition_has_trigger_and_owner.suggestion: Set when it applies and who answers for it.

conditional_grant_has_conditions.suggestion: Enter the conditions from the notice.

decision_has_notice_document.fail: The decision has no notice document.
decision_has_notice_document.suggestion: Attach the notice as a document revision.

dependency_acyclic.suggestion: Remove one dependency of the cycle.

discharge_has_evidence_and_verifier.fail: A self-certified discharge lacks evidence or an independent verifier.
discharge_has_evidence_and_verifier.suggestion: Reopen the condition and discharge it with four eyes.

forecast_before_needed_by.fail: The decision is forecast {days} days after the schedule needs it.
forecast_before_needed_by.suggestion: File earlier, agree a faster procedure or move the activity.

permit_not_lapsing.fail: The permit lapses on {until} unless work starts.
permit_not_lapsing.suggestion: Notify the start or apply for an extension.

requirement_has_applicant_and_owner.fail: Permit {code} has no applicant or no internal owner.
requirement_has_applicant_and_owner.suggestion: Name the applicant and the responsible person.

suspensive_condition_blocks_start.fail: Suspensive condition {number} is open: the permit does not take effect for site start.
suspensive_condition_blocks_start.suggestion: Meet and discharge the condition before starting.

unconfirmed_figure_used.suggestion: Check the figure on the cited source.
